name: discord-php-extended/discordphp-mtgpocket
description: A Magic: The Gathering collectible card game played through Discord, in the style of Pokémon TCG Pocket. Built on DiscordPHP-MTG.

scripts-descriptions.pint: Format src, tests, bin and bot.php with Laravel Pint.
scripts-descriptions.cs-unsupported: Run php-cs-fixer on a PHP version it does not support yet.
scripts-descriptions.coverage: Write an HTML coverage report to coverage/ (needs Xdebug).
scripts-descriptions.docs: Build the class reference into build/ with phpDocumentor (install discord-php/phpdoc-tool into phpdoc-tool/ first).
scripts-descriptions.phpacker: Build a standalone binary for bot.php (all platforms).
scripts-descriptions.phpacker:bot: Build a standalone binary for bot.php into bin/build/bot.
scripts-descriptions.import-cards: Import per-set card pools from the MTGJSON build.
scripts-descriptions.card-coverage: Report how much card text the rules engine understands.
